name: Sunday Times cryptic crossword, book 1 No 22

clue.text: Silly riddle I cut out to set before infantile character
Tried putting a representative in the transport
Books of interest to gardeners
Country ale once brewed in Britain, paradoxically
He's taken his annual package tour
Cold roast sliced for them
Opened with fish in place of oysters
Frenchman is abducted in error
Cruising, likely to moor here
Small gifts with legs?
Policeman recruited — large numbers of them
Suit's a Parisian shape I fit into
Has a fresh excursion planned for New Year
Sheep takes bottle top from mount in poor condition
Trade in lots of vehicles
Gifts for people at the party
Freedom to hand down to posterity
Perform surgery on diseased tip of cypress trees
With this top dressing on grave, rose starts to make a showing
Materials replacing horsehair
Round chap's head stuck in Glasgow chimney? Get the doctor!
Weapon raised after journalist nodded
A ketch at sea gets fish for the author
Turn up ring bell then leave present outside — it's for the gardener
One of the team expected annually by air
Mother's pet dog
Assumed it must result in a certain loss of face
Let loose when adjacent keys move in combination
Take lid off chest to disclose present
Oil pollution engineers found in the river
